points.text: the lower / smaller the $\mathrm{p}K_{\mathrm{a}}$, the stronger the acid
(stronger than ethanoic acid because) $\mathrm{Cl}$ is electron-withdrawing
and so stabilises the $\mathrm{RCO_2^-}$ anion / conjugate base or weakens $\mathrm{O-H}$ bond (so $\mathrm{H^+}$ is more easily released)
$\mathrm{NH_3^+CH_2CO_2^- \longrightarrow NH_2CH_2CO_2^- + H^+}$ OR $\mathrm{NH_3^+CH_2CO_2^- + H_2O \longrightarrow NH_2CH_2CO_2^- + H_3O^+}$
vertical portion (end point) at vol added = $10.0\ \mathrm{cm}^3$
finishes at pH = 12.5 at $20\ \mathrm{cm}^3$ (and does not increase in pH)
